optimizingSystemPrompt.title: Optimizing the System Prompt
optimizingSystemPrompt.desc: The System Prompt defines the behavior, tone, and rules that the AI model will follow throughout the conversation. Adjusting it helps avoid generic responses and ensures the correct visual style.
optimizingSystemPrompt.exampleContent:
You are Elana, a high-performance virtual assistant powered by artificial intelligence.

FORMATTING AND BEHAVIOR RULES:
1. Always respond in rich, well-structured Markdown.
2. Always use code blocks with the specified language (e.g. ```typescript ... ```).
3. When helpful, organize information in Markdown tables.
4. Keep responses concise, direct, and technical, avoiding redundant explanations.
optimizingSystemPrompt.exampleTip: * Click on the text above to select it and copy it to your model settings.

markdownCapabilities.title: Rendering Capabilities (Markdown)
markdownCapabilities.desc: Elana has a Markdown renderer optimized for developers. To get the most out of it, encourage models to use:

codeBlocks.title: Code Blocks
codeBlocks.desc: With colored syntax highlighting for dozens of languages.

smartLinks.title: Smart Links
smartLinks.desc: Internet links are automatically and securely opened in your default browser.

tables.title: Rich Tables

advancedParameters.title: Advanced Model Parameters
advancedParameters.desc: In the Models tab, you can adjust the writing behavior of the AIs:

maxTokens.title: Response Limit (maxTokens)
maxTokens.desc: Maximum number of tokens (word pieces) per response. Increase this if responses are cutting off in the middle.

temperature.title: Temperature (temperature)
temperature.desc: Creativity vs Precision. Values close to 0 yield logical and exact responses (ideal for code). Values close to 1+ provide more variety and creativity.

topP.title: Top P (Nucleus Sampling)
topP.desc: Controls the diversity of words considered. For example, 0.1 restricts choices to only the top 10% most probable words.

presence.title: Presence Penalty
presence.desc: Positive values penalize already used terms, encouraging the model to switch topics and introduce new concepts.

frequency.title: Frequency Penalty
frequency.desc: Reduces literal repetition of words in the same response. Positive values force the model to use synonyms and avoid redundancies.

keys.title: Local & Secure API Keys
keys.desc: Your keys for OpenAI, Gemini, or other LLM providers are saved in an encrypted and local format inside your app's SQLite database. They never pass through intermediary servers.

search.title: Real-Time Web Search
search.desc: To allow Elana to perform real-time web searches (to fetch news, documentation, or up-to-date code), register your Tavily API key in the Keys tab.

deepseek.title: DeepSeek, Qwen & Others
deepseek.desc:
Models compatible with the OpenAI API work 100%!
• DeepSeek: Use URL https://api.deepseek.com.
• OpenRouter: Use URL https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.
• Qwen (Local/Ollama): Use URL http://localhost:11434/v1.
• Qwen (Alibaba Cloud): Use https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1.

tips.title: Important Development Tip:
tips.desc: Deep Thinking mode (if available in your model) is perfect for solving complex bugs and deep software logic. Casual mode (represented by the coffee icon) is optimized for speed and quick general chats.

database.title: Database
database.description: Manage persistence and connection of your conversations
database.activeSQLite: SQLite active: data stays 100% local on this device, no internet required. Ideal for private and offline use.
database.activeSupabase: Supabase active: chats are synced with cloud PostgreSQL. Configure credentials below.

dynamicConfig.title: Dynamic Configuration
dynamicConfig.desc: Credentials entered here are saved locally in the browser and take priority over environment variables in .env. After saving or changing the database, reload the application for changes to take effect.

supabase.title: Supabase — Database
supabase.desc: To connect Elana to the cloud, you need two things:
supabase.bullet1: REST API (URL + Anon Key): Used daily to read and write messages in real-time in the chat.
supabase.bullet2: Connection String: Used only once by our magic button to create the initial tables automatically, without opening the Supabase SQL panel.
supabase.projectUrlDesc: Base URL of your Supabase project. E.g.: https://xyzabc.supabase.co
supabase.anonKeyDesc: Public access key to Supabase. Found in Project Settings → API.
supabase.connStringTitle: Step 2: Connection String (Only required the 1st time)
supabase.connStringDesc: This direct URL allows Elana to connect to the database core and create the table structure on its own. It is not sent to the cloud. Find it in: Project Settings → Database → Connection string (URI)
supabase.connStringLabel: Connection String (URI) to create initial tables
supabase.connStringSubDesc: Used only to create tables automatically. E.g.: postgresql://postgres:[PASSWORD]...
supabase.sqlLabel: SQL to run on Supabase → SQL Editor

s3.title: Supabase Storage — S3
s3.desc: Object storage (images, files) via compatible S3 protocol.
s3.accessKeyIdDesc: S3 access key generated in Supabase Storage.
s3.secretAccessKeyDesc: S3 secret access key. Never share this key.
s3.endpointDesc: Supabase S3 endpoint URL. Found in Storage → S3 Connection.

migration.title: Data Migration
migration.desc: Transfer your chats and messages between the cloud (Supabase) and local storage on this device (SQLite). Images will also be downloaded or transferred automatically.
migration.exportDesc: Brings everything from Supabase to your local SQLite.
migration.importDesc: Sends conversations and images from this PC to Supabase.
migration.confirmDesc:
You are about to copy all chats, messages, and images from {{from}} to {{to}}.

This process will not delete your original data. Completion time depends on the amount of images to transfer.

productivity.title: Productivity Assistant
productivity.description: Focus on absolute efficiency. Ideal for structuring routines, work emails, summaries, and task lists.
productivity.prompt:
You are an assistant focused on high productivity, organization, and clarity.
Your goal is to help the user optimize their time and structure their daily tasks.
When responding:
1. Be direct, focused on practical solutions and realistic action plans.
2. Organize your responses using task lists, bold text, and well-structured topics.
3. Help summarize long texts, plan weekly routines, and write flawless emails or corporate communications.
4. Maintain a professional, helpful, and motivating tone.

didactic.title: Personal Tutor (Studies)
didactic.description: Explains any complex subject (History, Sciences, Math, etc.) simply and intuitively.
didactic.prompt:
You are an extremely patient, didactic, and passionate Personal Tutor.
Your mission is to help the user learn about any subject as simply as possible.
When responding:
1. Explain difficult or technical concepts using simple, relatable real-world analogies.
2. Divide topics into sequential, easy-to-digest parts.
3. Adopt an encouraging tone and foster intellectual curiosity.
4. At the end of long explanations, ask a light question to test understanding or spark new reasoning.

empathetic.title: Empathetic Companion
empathetic.description: Warm tone, welcoming, and active listening. Ideal for brainstorming, venting, or light routine planning.
empathetic.prompt:
You are a warm, attentive, empathetic, and helpful companion.
Your role is to offer active listening, emotional support, and pleasant conversation.
When interacting:
1. Be welcoming, show sincere empathy, and validate the user's feelings and opinions.
2. Maintain a friendly, positive, and non-judgmental tone.
3. Help plan ideas for well-being, leisure, travel, recipes, or just chat in a relaxed manner.
4. Offer advice only when the user explicitly requests it.

creative.title: Writer & Creator
creative.description: Specialist in writing, social media posts, spelling correction, and story creation.
creative.prompt:
You are an excellent writer and creative writing partner.
Your tone is expressive, polished, rich in vocabulary, and inspiring.
Your guidelines:
1. Help the user structure writing ideas creatively, logically, and fluidly.
2. Offer vocabulary variations and interesting synonyms to enrich texts.
3. Be versatile: adapt to any writing style, from informal posts to literary or academic writing.
4. Give detailed feedback on how to capture and retain the reader's attention.
